title: Have you lost your PackshotCreator or Ortery software?
h1: Recover your PackshotCreator or Ortery software
metaTitle: Recover your lost PackshotCreator or Ortery software - Solutions and alternatives
description: Problems with your PackshotCreator or Ortery software? Learn how to get your license back, fix Windows 11 compatibility issues, and explore modern alternatives.
author: PackshotCreator
content:
For over 20 years, PackshotCreator has enabled thousands of companies to produce professional-quality visuals in-house thanks to automated photography solutions. However, in 2025, many users contacted us with the same problem: lost PackshotCreator software, a studio not recognized by Windows 11, or inability to reinstall the system after changing computers.
If this applies to you, here is the up-to-date information you need to understand the situation and find out what solutions are available.

Why is your software no longer available?

All the software supplied with PackshotCreator studios between 2003 and 2024 was developed by Ortery Technologies, a Taiwan-based company and a pioneer in automated photography since 2001.
For over 20 years, PackshotCreator was the exclusive distributor of Ortery in EMEA, marketing these software and hardware solutions under its own brand. But since the end of 2024:

  • PackshotCreator no longer distributes Ortery software
  • The PackshotCreator support for these solutions officially ended on December 31, 2024

Software development continues at Ortery. For any technical questions, reinstallation or license requests, you must contact the publisher directly.

What should you do if you lost the software or changed your PC?

Here are the steps to follow if you run into problems:

Step 1: Identify your hardware

‍

‍

  • Studio name (e.g. PackshoTone, R3 Mark II, Spin O3T...)
  • Serial number, if available
  • Year of purchase and the software version used

Step 2: Contact Ortery Technologies

Ortery is now your only point of contact to:

  • Download PackshotCreator or PackshotSpin software
  • Reactivate a license
  • Get technical support for previous versions

Ortery Technologies B.V.

Significant compatibility issues

Even if you find the software, it is important to be aware of some limitations:
Ortery solutions have limited compatibility with Windows 11. You may run into problems if your camera is no longer recognized. Installing the software may fail or freeze on recent systems.
In these cases, getting the studio working again is seldom possible. It is then time to consider a migration to a modern solution that is compatible with current standards.

Orbitvu: the new generation of automated studios

Since 2023, PackshotCreator has been the official distributor of Orbitvu solutions, which are faster, more intuitive and compatible with modern technologies (Windows 11, Mac, cloud...).

The advantages of modern Orbitvu solutions

‍

‍

  • AI photo assistant built in to guide your shots
  • Virtual lighting with 74 lamps that can be controlled separately
  • Automated background removal and retouching to save time
  • E-commerce export in one click to the main platforms
  • 360° animation and product videos of professional quality
  • Full compatibility with Mac/PC, PIM, DAM, marketplaces, e-commerce

Discover Alphashot PRO G2

Key advantages of Orbitvu compared to older studios

Modern Orbitvu solutions offer several major advantages over the old PackshotCreator/Ortery solutions:

  • Extensive compatibility: full support for Windows 11 and macOS, unlike the old studios, which were limited to Windows XP, 7 or 10
  • Automatic background removal: backgrounds removed instantly, with no manual handling
  • Intuitive user assistant: step-by-step guidance, even for beginners
  • Automated e-commerce export: considerable time savings when putting products online
  • Advanced and controllable lighting: precise control via multiple virtual light sources

See also: Comparison of Alphashot XL PRO vs PackshotCreator R3

Why reinternalize your visual production?

The new Orbitvu tools allow you to:

  • Reduce your external costs
  • Speed up the online launch of your products
  • Maintain consistent visual quality
  • Automate background removal, naming and export

See also: Is it useful to internalize your packshot photo production?

In summary

If you have lost your PackshotCreator or PackshotSpin software: contact Ortery Technologies, the publisher and developer, directly.
If your hardware is no longer compatible with Windows 11: schedule an Orbitvu demo to discover modern alternatives.
Our team is here to support you.

Need more information? Contact our team or visit our site to discover all of our Orbitvu solutions.

faqs.question: Is Ortery software compatible with Windows 11?
faqs.answer: Yes, the most recent Ortery software versions are fully compatible with Windows 11. However, the versions delivered with PackshotCreator studios between 2003 and 2020 generally are not. If you're still using software originally supplied by PackshotCreator, it's likely that it will no longer work properly on modern systems, due to driver incompatibilities, unsupported cameras, or general software instability.

faqs.question: Why not just keep using my PackshotCreator studio if the software is updated by Ortery?
faqs.answer: Technically, you may be able to get your studio running again by contacting Ortery directly. This assumes your equipment is still supported, your technical environment is compatible (camera, connections, operating system), and that you're willing to forgo the functional improvements offered by more recent solutions. In practice, keeping an old studio in operation often becomes a constraint in terms of time, reliability, and productivity.

faqs.question: What is the point of migrating to Orbitvu if Ortery continues to evolve its software?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu takes a more modern and fully integrated approach, designed for current content production workflows. The studios come with advanced features such as real-time background removal, software-controlled virtual lighting, and a guided interface to simplify operations. Everything is centralized within Orbitvu Station, a single, professional-grade software platform. In addition, Orbitvu solutions are backed by full local support through PackshotCreator, including demonstrations, training, and tailored integration advice.

faqs.question: My Ortery/PackshotCreator studio is still working. Why should I consider replacing it?
faqs.answer: Just because a system works doesn't mean it's still effective. The real question is whether it allows you to produce visual content quickly, easily, and to current standards. In 2025, Orbitvu enables full autonomy, consistent image quality regardless of the user, and seamless integration with your business tools (PIM, e-commerce, DAM, etc.). For most teams, production time is reduced by a factor of three to five, with a direct impact on cost and delivery times.

faqs.question: Do you offer upgrade or trade-in offers for old PackshotCreator or Ortery studios?
faqs.answer: Yes, PackshotCreator offers a trade-in program for customers with older PackshotCreator or Ortery studios. This includes a free diagnostic of your current setup, a trade-in valuation for your existing equipment, a commercial offer on a new Orbitvu studio adapted to your needs (static, 360°, or video photography), and complete support including demonstration, training, and integration. The goal is to ensure a smooth, fast transition with no production downtime, while giving you access to the latest technological advancements.
